places.name: Sakumono Beach
places.description: Golden shoreline popular with families, swimmers, and photographers looking for calm Atlantic views near the city.

places.name: Tema Harbor
places.address: Harbor Road, Tema Port, Greater Accra
places.description: Ghana's busiest seaport offers guided tours explaining container logistics, fishing fleets, and regional trade routes.

places.name: Community 1 Market
places.description: A vibrant open-air market selling fresh produce, spices, textiles, and handmade goods from local vendors.

places.name: Meridian Park
places.description: Shaded lawns, playgrounds, and walking paths make this park a favorite weekend gathering spot for residents.

places.name: Tema Roundabout
places.description: The city's iconic central junction features public art celebrating Tema's maritime heritage and planned urban design.

places.name: Tema Cultural Centre
places.description: Hosts drumming workshops, dance performances, and seasonal festivals that showcase Ga traditions and coastal culture.

places.name: Kpone Fishing Village
places.description: Watch fishermen haul nets at dawn and sample grilled tilapia served steps from the boats that caught it.

places.name: Industrial Heritage Tour
places.description: Learn how Tema's manufacturing zone produces goods for export and supports thousands of local jobs.

places.name: Tema Sports Stadium
places.description: Catch regional football matches and community athletics events in this open-air stadium near the city center.

places.name: Waterfront Promenade
places.description: A paved walkway along the shore ideal for evening strolls, jogging, and watching ships enter the harbor.

places.name: Chop Bar Alley
places.description: Sample jollof rice, grilled fish, and kelewele from family-run eateries loved by port workers and visitors alike.

places.name: Tema Craft Village
places.description: Artisans sell beads, kente cloth, wood carvings, and souvenirs crafted in workshops behind their stalls.

places.name: Coastal Bird Sanctuary
places.description: Migratory birds rest along the lagoon trails where guided walks explain wetland ecology and conservation efforts.

places.name: Harbor Night Market
places.description: After sunset the waterfront fills with food stalls, live music, and vendors selling crafts under string lights.

places.name: Tema Public Library
places.description: A quiet stop for travelers researching local history with archives on Tema's founding and port development.

places.name: Traditional Canoe Launch
places.description: Colorful wooden canoes depart at sunrise as crews paddle beyond the breakers to cast nets in the open sea.

places.name: Colonial Heritage Walk
places.description: A self-guided route past early township planning sites that shaped one of West Africa's first modern port cities.

places.name: Atlantic Sunset Point
places.description: The best west-facing viewpoint for dramatic sunsets over the Gulf of Guinea with unobstructed ocean horizons.
